supporting_news.title: Integrum Energy Infrastructure files papers with Sebi to raise funds via IPO
supporting_news.summary: Integrum Energy Infrastructure has launched its initial public offering (IPO) to secure funds for diverse operational enhancements. The firm intends to bolster its working capital while also expanding its portfolio of renewable energy projects. This marks a renewed effort at listing, following a previous pause.
